R Basic Course Mardones, Mauricio. & Zúñiga, María José. 2025-02-11 About Course_R Description and educational material for introductory course on R, descriptive statistics, and visualizations with applications in fisheries. This course has these sections; useR. Intro to R and basic features. Exploratory Data Analysis. Basic concepts for data exploration. Essential statistical calculations. Visualization. Graphics and Maps using modern packages Efficient code. Organization strategies. Automatization and sharing Report generation and result sharing.
